text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Many seasons have passed since Vodka
and
Daiwa Scarlet's initial springtime
showdown. And
now, they'll settle the
score today at the autumn
Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What's that? Are you sucking up to me
all of a
sudden?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No way. I'm just sayin' that since you're
now
number one, there's more meaning
in beatin' ya.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna show ya there's a better way
to live
than bein' number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You're not going to show me
anything.
You're not going to win, after
all.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, confident as ever. You haven't
changed a
bit since we met.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for you. But I'm glad
we're both
just as stubborn.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If one of us were weak and docile... they
would
just drag the other one down.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Both of us would be finished. I'm sure of
it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. It's because neither of us
gave in
that we're here today.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haha, we're both hopeless. Hopeless,
but
awesome!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so the race begins—a competition
between
two Umamusume who'll never
give the other even
an inch.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Here we go! I can't be number one if I
don't beat
you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna beat you while you're number
one and
become the coolest in history!
